sentences.text: Chronicity: itching spans 49 days, 18 episodes on 18 days, most recent 1 day ago; 49 days is a floor, and the record cannot show how long the sign predates it.
Diet trial (owner-entered): Vetline Hydrolysed Soy, from Aug 17, 2026, day 61 of 84.
No medication or supplement is recorded as overlapping the trial, not checked with the owner.

checker.takeaway: Dog has had itching for at least 49 days (18 episodes on 18 days, last 1 day ago), is on day 61 of 84 of an owner-entered hydrolysed soy diet trial, and no overlapping meds are recorded; the vet would likely conclude the trial is running cleanly with no confounders.

omissions: Trial adherence and off-list exposure (treats, other foods, chews) are not recorded, so the trial cannot be taken as clean; the summary does not say this.
The 18 itching days are out of 56 logged days in the Aug 22 to Oct 16 window, and the trial started before the window opened, so the itching baseline before the diet change is not visible.
